bns-2023.name: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
bns-2023.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

bnss-2023.name: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
bnss-2023.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.

bsa-2023.name: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
bsa-2023.long_title: An Act to consolidate and to provide for general rules and principles of evidence for fair trial.

arbitration-1996.name: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
arbitration-1996.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to domestic arbitration, international commercial arbitration and enforcement of foreign arbitral awards as also to define the law relating to conciliation and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

consumer-2019.name: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
consumer-2019.enforcement_date: 24th July, 2020.-- S. 2 clauses (4), (13), (14), (16), (40), s. 10 to 27 (both inclusive), sub-clause (iv) of clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 58, s. 88, 89, 92 and 93, 94, 96, 97 and 99, clause (f) to (m) of sub-section 2 and clauses (zg), (zh) and (zi) of sub-section 2 of s. 101, 104, vide notification No. S.O. 2421(E), dated 23rd July 2020, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
consumer-2019.long_title: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration and settlement of consumers' disputes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
consumer-2019.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

cpc-1908.name: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
cpc-1908.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to the procedure of the Courts of Civil Judicature.

ni-1881.name: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
ni-1881.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

it-2000.name: The Information Technology Act, 2000
it-2000.long_title: An Act to provide legal recognition for transactions carried out by means of electronic data interchange and other means of electronic communication, commonly referred to as
it-2000.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

stamp-1899.name: The Indian Stamp Act, 1899
stamp-1899.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Stamps,
